abstract: Economists frequently assert that politicians derive financial returns from a political career, but these returns can be obscured by the varying duration of political careers. In this study, I estimate the financial returns associated with successive mandates in the Lower House, capitalizing on the repetitive treatment assignment through close elections in the Netherlands from 1848–1917. Employing a dynamic regression discontinuity framework, I establish that the financial benefits accruing to politicians are due to the first two periods of political tenure, but no substantial returns emerge during the more advanced career stages. These findings emphasize that politicians elected for a first and second term exhibit significantly higher end-of-life wealth than their losing counterparts, equivalent to several years’ salaries. I also explore various potential mechanisms, providing evidence in favor of career-based explanations and against in-office returns. • Dynamic RD estimates financial returns to Dutch political tenure (1848–1917). • Gains concentrate in the first two terms; no wealth premium for longer careers. • Electoral success aids a lucrative pivot to the private legal sector in cities. • There is little evidence for in-office rent-seeking or corruption.
title: Dynamic returns to political tenure

abstract: In two separate field experiments with Swedish school children aged 10–16, we evaluate Environmental Education Programs designed to promote pro-environmental behavior; specifically, reduce household waste. We match the addresses of participating students with high-resolution administrative records on collected household waste. This allows us to estimate causal effects on the waste generated in households where a child was treated. Across both experiments, we find no detectable reductions in household waste. In the second experiment, we are also able to estimate the effect of regular environmental education within the Swedish school curriculum, and find little indication that this affects household waste.
abstract_zh: 在针对瑞典10至16岁学龄儿童开展的两项独立实地实验中，我们评估了旨在促进亲环境行为、特别是减少家庭废弃物的环境教育项目。我们将参与学生的住址与高分辨率行政记录中收集的家庭废弃物数据进行匹配，从而能够估计儿童接受干预后对其家庭产生废弃物量的因果效应。在两项实验中，我们均未发现家庭废弃物有可检测的减少。在第二项实验中，我们还能估计瑞典学校课程中常规环境教育的影响，并发现几乎没有迹象表明这会影响家庭废弃物。
title: Can teaching children about the environment influence household behavior? Experiments in Swedish schools
title_zh: 教授儿童环境知识能否影响家庭行为？瑞典学校的实验

abstract: If old firms are, on average, much larger than young firms, does this mean that firms get better with age? Using Danish administrative data on firms aged 0–65, we study the relationship between size and age. In the cross-section, average size is increasing with age. However, by exploiting the panel structure through the estimation of fixed effects or by using a partial identification approach to the so-called age–period–cohort problem, we find evidence that firm size increases with age only for the first 10–15 years, and falls after that. Moreover, sample composition effects seem to be important to understand the patterns in the cross-section: we find significant differences in exit rates by firm size and strong cohort effects for firms entering in the late 1950s. We also find that the exit rate is not monotonically decreasing with age; for smaller firms, it starts increasing again in their 20s, spiking in their late 30s.
abstract_zh: 如果老企业平均而言远大于年轻企业，这是否意味着企业会随年龄增长而变得更好？利用丹麦0至65岁企业的行政数据，我们研究了规模与年龄之间的关系。在横截面上，平均规模随年龄增长而增加。然而，通过利用面板结构进行固定效应估计，或采用部分识别方法处理所谓的年龄-时期-队列问题，我们发现企业规模仅在最初10至15年内随年龄增长，之后则下降。此外，样本构成效应似乎对理解横截面模式至关重要：我们发现不同规模企业的退出率存在显著差异，且对1950年代末期进入的企业存在强烈的队列效应。我们还发现，退出率并非随年龄单调递减；对于较小企业，退出率在20多岁时再次上升，并在30多岁后期达到峰值。
title: Old firms and the relationship between age and size
title_zh: 老企业与年龄和规模之间的关系

abstract: Using a nonlinear VAR, we examine the asymmetric effects of shocks to long-run inflation expectations. Negative shocks, which temporarily lower long-run inflation expectations, have a stronger and more persistent impact on output, investment, and firm entry compared to positive shocks. We provide a novel theoretical explanation, demonstrating how these shocks influence the second-order components of the model, shaping firms' “wait-and-see” behavior—particularly along both the intensive and extensive margins of the investment channel.
abstract_zh: 利用非线性VAR模型，我们考察了长期通胀预期冲击的非对称效应。相较于正向冲击，负向冲击虽暂时降低长期通胀预期，但对产出、投资及企业进入的影响更为强劲且持久。我们提出了一种新颖的理论解释，展示了这些冲击如何作用于模型的二阶成分，塑造企业的“观望”行为——尤其是在投资渠道的集约边际与扩展边际上。
title: Nonlinearities With Deanchored Inflation Expectations
title_zh: 去锚定通胀预期的非线性特征
